V2-045D planning complete (handoff = implemented design): harness cancelInbox/switchInboxDelivery on OpenCodePromptClient (status only, no body); outbox cancel: allowed admitted/uncertain, fence none->requested->submitting persisted before DELETE (write failure -> notPersisted, no request), NotSent -> requested+reason, else uncertain then locate: pending same text -> admitted+cancelPending (fence open), promoted -> delivered+settled, absent -> cancelled+cancelled only if previously admitted else uncertain+cancellationFence, incomplete/occupied/read failure -> state kept, fence open; fence never cleared/reopened; reconcile rechecks admitted/uncertain entries with an open fence read-only; switch: admitted+fence none only, PATCH then locate (inbox delivery is the truth; promoted -> delivered; absent -> cancelled; failures keep admitted); payload never changes; cancelled evictable. Rejected: Muse-xhigh fence->none on pending, Cat fence->none on refusal and 409=>delivered, Codex-2 originalDelivery/pendingDelivery fields (unneeded: switched entries are admitted and never replayed), Codex no-DELETE-before-observed (DELETE of an unknown id is a harmless no-op; outcome rules already refuse to claim).
